body_ar: عمر الإنسان في هذه الدنيا قصير، فهو أيام معدودة وأنفاس محدودة، ثم ينتقل إلى ربه تعالى فيدخله الجنة أو النار، وقد جعل الله الحياة الدنيا داراً للابتلاء وساحة لمواجهة الأعداء، فأعداء الإنسان في هذه الحياة يحيطون به من كل جانب: النفس والشيطان والدنيا والهوى وإخوان السوء، ولا عدة للمؤمن في مجابهة جميع أعدائه إلا الصبر، وكفى به عدة وزاداً وسلاحاً. أعمار الإنسان التي جعلها الله سبحانه وتعالى له: الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته. أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى جعل للإنسان خمسة أعمار: ..
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* A person's lifetime in this world is short: it is numbered days and a limited count of breaths, and then he passes on to his Lord, exalted is He, who admits him to the Garden or to the Fire. God has made the life of this world an abode of trial and an arena for confronting enemies; and a person's enemies in this life surround him on every side — the self, Satan, the world, caprice, and evil companions. The believer has no provision in confronting all his enemies except patience, and it suffices as provision, as sustenance and as a weapon.

## The lifetimes that God, glorified and exalted is He, has appointed for the human being

Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. Peace be upon you, and God's mercy and His blessings. To proceed:

God, glorified and exalted is He, has appointed for the human being five lifetimes: ..

flags.note: 'ʿuddah' is what one lays in and makes ready against a coming need, and the synopsis develops it in military terms — provision, sustenance, weapon — against enemies who surround a person. 'Provision' is used to keep that sense, and is distinct from the 'ʿiddah' of the glossary, which is the waiting period in family law and has nothing to do with this word.

translator_notes: One of a run of thirteen records, IDs 688-700, all uploaded on 5 and 8-9 May 2011 within a few hours of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-a-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lessons were delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart.
